# HEM v0.8.2

- One room face combines thermal comfort, humidity and air quality. The Home setting shows or hides it across the dashboard. Room gear, alerts and live heating, cooling, drying and fan icons sit together inside the name tab, above the compact readings. AQI tiles show the index or provider scale once.
- The dashboard retries interrupted card downloads, including when the iOS Companion App resumes or reconnects. A compressed card resource reduces the initial download.
- The post-shutdown watchdog can start fresh observations for dedicated coolers, dehumidifiers and humidifiers already reporting OFF. It also monitors known shutdown directions on multi-mode appliances. Independent room and outdoor evidence helps distinguish continued output from incoming cold, dry or humid air. Before repeating OFF, HEM checks fresh measurements and the target again. Each episode retains its two-attempt limit across restarts and long idle periods.
- The README includes the full settings directory and new English screenshots of the five-room dashboard and expanded bathroom.

Install the stable update through HACS and restart Home Assistant to load the updated integration.
